concepts.label: Entity Common Stock, Shares Outstanding
concepts.description: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

concepts.label: Entity Number of Employees
concepts.description: Number of persons employed by the Entity

concepts.label: Entity Public Float
concepts.description: The aggregate market value of the voting and non-voting common equity held by non-affiliates computed by reference to the price at which the common equity was last sold, or the average bid and asked price of such common equity, as of the last business day of the registrant's most recently completed second fiscal quarter.

concepts.label: Derivative, Notional Amount
concepts.description: Aggregate notional amount specified by the derivative(s). Expressed as an absolute value.

concepts.label: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due within one year (or the operating cycle, if longer), including liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received, taxes, interest, rent and utilities, accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

concepts.label: Accounts Payable, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Construction Contractor, Receivable, Excluding Contract Retainage
concepts.description: Amount billed to customers under long-term contracts or programs but not paid. Excludes amounts due that have been withheld because of retainage provisions in a contract.

concepts.label: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
concepts.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business.

concepts.label: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as current.

concepts.label: Accrued Participation Liabilities, Due in Next Operating Cycle
concepts.description: The amount of accrued participation liabilities that it expects to pay during the upcoming operating cycle.

concepts.label: Accrued Rent, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for contractual rent under lease arrangements. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment
concepts.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization for physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

concepts.label: AOCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Adjustment, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

concepts.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cumulative Changes in Net Gain (Loss) from Cash Flow Hedges, Effect Net of Tax
concepts.description: Accumulated change, net of tax, in accumulated gains and losses from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges. Includes an entity's share of an equity investee's Increase or Decrease in deferred hedging gains or losses.

concepts.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

concepts.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Accumulated adjustment, net of tax, that results from the process of translating subsidiary financial statements and foreign equity investments into the reporting currency from the functional currency of the reporting entity, net of reclassification of realized foreign currency translation gains or losses.

concepts.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
concepts.description: Accumulated change in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, net of tax effect, at period end. Excludes Net Income (Loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners. Includes foreign currency translation items, certain pension adjustments, unrealized gains and losses on certain investments in debt and equity securities, other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses related to factors other than credit losses on available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities that an entity does not intend to sell and it is not more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell before recovery of the amortized cost basis, as well as changes in the fair value of derivatives related to the effective portion of a designated cash flow hedge.

concepts.label: Additional Collateral, Aggregate Fair Value
concepts.description: The aggregate fair value of additional assets that would be required to be posted as collateral for derivative instruments with credit-risk-related contingent features if the credit-risk-related contingent features were triggered at the end of the reporting period.

concepts.label: Additional Paid in Capital
concepts.description: Excess of issue price over par or stated value of the entity's capital stock and amounts received from other transactions involving the entity's stock or stockholders. Includes adjustments to additional paid in capital. Some examples of such adjustments include recording the issuance of debt with a beneficial conversion feature and certain tax consequences of equity instruments awarded to employees. Use this element for the aggregate amount of additional paid-in capital associated with common and preferred stock. For additional paid-in capital associated with only common stock, use the element additional paid in capital, common stock. For additional paid-in capital associated with only preferred stock, use the element additional paid in capital, preferred stock.

concepts.label: Additional Paid in Capital, Common Stock
concepts.description: Value received from shareholders in common stock-related transactions that are in excess of par value or stated value and amounts received from other stock-related transactions. Includes only common stock transactions (excludes preferred stock transactions). May be called contributed capital, capital in excess of par, capital surplus, or paid-in capital.

concepts.label: Segment Reporting Information, Expenditures for Additions to Long-Lived Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Total expenditures for additions to long-lived assets other than financial instruments, long-term customer relationships of a financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition costs, and deferred tax assets of the reportable segment; if the amount: (a) is included in the determination of segment assets reviewed by the chief operating decision maker or (b) is otherwise regularly provided to the chief operating decision maker, even if not included in the determination of segment assets.

concepts.label: Additions to Other Assets, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of significant additions in the period in other assets (current, noncurrent, or unclassified).

concepts.label: Adjustments, Noncash Items, to Reconcile Net Income (Loss) to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
concepts.description: The aggregate amount of adjustments to net income or loss necessary to remove the effects of all items whose cash effects are investing or financing cash flows. The aggregate amount also includes all noncash expenses and income items which reduce or increase net income and are thus added back or deducted when calculating cash provided by or used in operating activities.

concepts.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Issued, Issuance Costs
concepts.description: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from direct costs associated with issuing stock. Includes, but is not limited to, legal and accounting fees and direct costs associated with stock issues under a shelf registration.

concepts.label: Adjustments to Reconcile Net Income (Loss) to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
concepts.description: The sum of adjustments which are added to or deducted from net income or loss, including the portion attributable to noncontrolling interest, to reflect cash provided by or used in operating activities, in accordance with the indirect cash flow method.

concepts.label: Advertising Expense
concepts.description: Amount charged to advertising expense for the period, which are expenses incurred with the objective of increasing revenue for a specified brand, product or product line.

concepts.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense
concepts.description: Amount of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount capitalized.

concepts.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concepts.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as current.

concepts.label: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Investing Activities
concepts.description: Cash inflow due to change during the period in the allowance for other funds used during construction classified as an investing activity.

concepts.label: Amortization of Intangible Assets
concepts.description: The aggregate expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of intangible assets (nonphysical assets not used in production) in a systematic and rational manner to the periods expected to benefit from such assets. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

concepts.label: Antidilutive Securities Excluded from Computation of Earnings Per Share, Amount
concepts.description: Securities (including those issuable pursuant to contingent stock agreements) that could potentially dilute basic earnings per share (EPS) or earnings per unit (EPU) in the future that were not included in the computation of diluted EPS or EPU because to do so would increase EPS or EPU amounts or decrease loss per share or unit amounts for the period presented.

concepts.label: Assets
concepts.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

concepts.label: Assets, Current
concepts.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold, or consumed within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

concepts.label: Assets Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, in Period of Disposition, Gain (Loss) on Disposition
concepts.description: Amount of gain (loss) from the disposal of an asset through means other than sale, for example, but not limited to, abandonment, spin-off, and expropriation.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Assets
concepts.description: Amount classified as assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Assets, Current
concepts.description: Amount classified as assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Year One
concepts.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
concepts.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

concepts.label: Bridge Loan
concepts.description: Short-Term financing which is expected to be paid back relatively quickly, such as by a subsequent longer-term loan. Also called swing loan or bridge financing.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Cash Paid (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of cash paid to acquire the entity.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Equity Interests Issued and Issuable (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The acquisition-date fair value of the equity interests of the acquirer, including the number of instruments or interests issued or issuable in consideration for the business combination.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Purchase Price (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The total cost of the acquired entity including the cash paid to shareholders of acquired entities, fair value of debt and equity securities issued to shareholders of acquired entities, the fair value of the liabilities assumed, and direct costs of the acquisition.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Percentage of Voting Interests Acquired
concepts.description: Percentage of voting equity interests acquired at the acquisition date in the business combination.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Earnings Per Share, Basic
concepts.description: The pro forma basic net income per share for a period as if the business combination or combinations had been completed at the beginning of a period.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Earnings Per Share, Diluted
concepts.description: The pro forma diluted net income per share for a period as if the business combination or combinations had been completed at the beginning of a period.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Assets Acquired (Liabilities Assumed), Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The total purchase price of the acquired entity. This includes cash paid to equity interest holders of the acquired entity, fair value of debt and equity securities issued to equity holders of the acquired entity, and transaction costs paid to third parties to consummate the acquisition.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Goodwill Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of goodwill arising from a business combination, which is the excess of the cost of the acquired entity over the amounts assigned to assets acquired and liabilities assumed.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Property, Plant and Equipment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of acquisition cost of a business combination allocated to property, plant and equipment to be used in ongoing operations.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Net Income (Loss)
concepts.description: The pro forma net Income or Loss for the period as if the business combination or combinations had been completed at the beginning of a period.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Revenue
concepts.description: The pro forma revenue for a period as if the business combination or combinations had been completed at the beginning of the period.

concepts.label: Capital Lease Obligations
concepts.description: Amount equal to the present value (the principal) at the beginning of the lease term of minimum lease payments during the lease term (excluding that portion of the payments representing executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes to be paid by the lessor, together with any profit thereon) net of payments or other amounts applied to the principal through the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due, Next Twelve Months
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Five Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Four Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Three Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Two Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due Thereafter
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Cash
concepts.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
concepts.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease)
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalents. Cash and cash equivalents are the amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Includes effect from exchange rate changes.

concepts.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
concepts.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage. Excludes amount for disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

concepts.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash, cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; including effect from exchange rate change. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

concepts.label: Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
concepts.description: Amount of short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Cash Flows Between Transferor and Transferee, Proceeds from Collections Reinvested in Revolving Period Transfers
concepts.description: Cash Flows between a transferor and a transferee attributable to collections reinvested in revolving period transfers related to either a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the transferred financial assets underlying the transaction (including, but not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in the transferred financial assets).

concepts.label: Cash Flows Between Transferor and Transferee, Proceeds from New Transfers
concepts.description: Cash Flows between a transferor and a transferee attributable to newly transferred assets related to either a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the transferred financial assets underlying the transaction (including, but not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in the transferred financial assets).

concepts.label: Cash Flows Between Transferor and Transferee, Purchases of Previously Transferred Financial Assets
concepts.description: Cash Flows between a transferor and a transferee attributable to purchases of previously transferred financial assets (or its underlying collateral) related to a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the transferred financial assets underlying the transaction (including, but not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in the transferred financial assets).

concepts.label: Cash Paid for Capitalized Interest (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of cash paid during the current period for interest owed on money borrowed that is not charged as an expense but rather is capitalized based on the long term nature of the use of the borrowed funds.

concepts.label: Collateral Already Posted, Aggregate Fair Value
concepts.description: The aggregate fair value of assets that are already posted, at the end of the reporting period, as collateral for derivative instruments with credit-risk-related contingent features.

concepts.label: Commercial Paper
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of short-term borrowings using unsecured obligations issued by banks, corporations and other borrowers to investors. The maturities of these money market securities generally do not exceed 270 days.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Declared
concepts.description: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
concepts.description: Face amount or stated value per share of common stock.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares Authorized
concepts.description: The maximum number of common shares permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares, Issued
concepts.description: Total number of common shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders (includes common shares that were issued, repurchased and remain in the treasury). These shares represent capital invested by the firm's shareholders and owners, and may be all or only a portion of the number of shares authorized. Shares issued include shares outstanding and shares held in the treasury.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Value, Issued
concepts.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

concepts.label: Compensated Absences Liability
concepts.description: Amount of liability accrued for the employer's obligation related to an employee's right to receive compensation for future absences that have been earned by employee.

concepts.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
concepts.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

concepts.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income (loss) and other comprehensive income (loss), attributable to noncontrolling interests. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

concepts.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

concepts.label: Concentration Risk, Percentage (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: For an entity that discloses a concentration risk in relation to quantitative amount, which serves as the "benchmark" (or denominator) in the equation, this concept represents the concentration percentage derived from the division.

concepts.label: Concentration Risk, Percentage
concepts.description: "For an entity that discloses a concentration risk in relation to quantitative amount, which serves as the ""benchmark"" (or denominator) in the equation, this concept represents the concentration percentage derived from the division."

concepts.label: Consolidation, Less than Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Parent Ownership Interest, Changes, Purchase of Interest by Parent
concepts.description: Represents the purchase by the parent of an additional equity interest in a subsidiary during the period, thereby effecting a change in total (consolidated) equity attributable to the parent. The purchase of the additional equity interest represented by this element increases the parent's controlling interest in the subsidiary.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability
concepts.description: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Current
concepts.description: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Revenue Recognized
concepts.description: Amount of revenue recognized that was previously included in balance of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due.

concepts.label: Cost of Goods and Services Sold
concepts.description: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

concepts.label: Cost of Goods Sold, Excluding Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
concepts.description: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold during the reporting period, excluding depreciation, depletion, and amortization.

concepts.label: Cost of Revenue
concepts.description: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Cost of Services, Excluding Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
concepts.description: The aggregate cost of services rendered during the reporting period, excluding depreciation, depletion and amortization.

concepts.label: Costs and Expenses
concepts.description: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.

concepts.label: Cumulative Effect on Retained Earnings, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of the cumulative effect on retained earnings net of related income tax effect.

concepts.label: Current Federal Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of current federal tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Current Foreign Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of current foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Current State and Local Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of current state and local tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Customer Advances and Deposits
concepts.description: Refundable consideration, usually cash, held by the entity pending satisfactory completion of the entity's obligations or pending the closing of a contract.

concepts.label: Customer Advances and Deposits, Current
concepts.description: The current portion of aggregate prepayments received from customers for goods or services to be provided in the future, as well as the current portion of money or property received from customers that are to be returned upon satisfactory contract completion or as partial prepayment for goods or services to be provided in the future.

concepts.label: Debt, Current
concepts.description: Amount of short-term debt and current maturity of long-term debt and capital lease obligations due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt, Gross
concepts.description: Amount, before unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but is not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, commercial loans, mortgage loans, convertible debt, subordinated debt and other types of debt.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Face Amount
concepts.description: Face (par) amount of debt instrument at time of issuance.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage
concepts.description: Contractual interest rate for funds borrowed, under the debt agreement.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage Rate Range, Maximum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
concepts.description: Maximum contractual interest rate for funds borrowed, under the debt agreement.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage Rate Range, Minimum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
concepts.description: Minimum contractual interest rate for funds borrowed, under the debt agreement.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Repurchased Face Amount
concepts.description: Face (par) amount of the original debt instrument that was repurchased.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium), Net
concepts.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt discount (premium).

concepts.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Compensation Expense
concepts.description: The compensation expense recognized during the period pertaining to the deferred compensation arrangement.

concepts.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Recorded Liability
concepts.description: The carrying amount of the liability as of the balance sheet date to an individual under a deferred compensation arrangement. This amount may be the result of periodic accruals made over the period of active employment, or reflect termination benefits resulting contractual terms or a death benefit.

concepts.label: Deferred Compensation Liability, Classified, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements payable beyond one year (or the operating cycle, if longer).

concepts.label: Deferred Credits and Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of unearned revenue or income, not otherwise specified in the taxonomy, which is expected to be taken into income after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer and noncurrent obligations not separately disclosed in the balance sheet (other liabilities, noncurrent).

concepts.label: Deferred Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of deferred federal income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Net
concepts.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

concepts.label: Deferred Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Assets, Net
concepts.description: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, with jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Net
concepts.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Other Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of other deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations. For example, but not limited to, acquisition-date income tax benefits or expenses recognized from changes in the acquirer's valuation allowance for its previously existing deferred tax assets resulting from a business combination and adjustments to beginning-of-year balance of a valuation allowance because of a change in circumstance causing a change in judgment about the realizability of the related deferred tax asset in future periods.

concepts.label: Deferred Revenue
concepts.description: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

concepts.label: Deferred State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net
concepts.description: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, without jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net, Current
concepts.description: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, netted by jurisdiction and classified as current.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, with jurisdictional netting and classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance, Current
concepts.description: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards classified as current.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other
concepts.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from compensation and benefits costs.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance
concepts.description: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Net
concepts.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences without jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Net, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences, with jurisdictional netting and classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other
concepts.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences classified as other.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to employee service rendered, excluding assumptions about future compensation level.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Actuarial Gain (Loss)
concepts.description: Amount of gain (loss) from change in actuarial assumptions which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Assumptions include, but are not limited to, interest, mortality, employee turnover, salary, and temporary deviation from substantive plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Actuarial Gain (Loss), Immediate Recognition as Component in Net Periodic Benefit (Cost) Credit
concepts.description: Amount of gain (loss), recognized immediately as component of net periodic benefit (cost) credit, for change in value of benefit obligation or plan assets from experience different from that assumed, change in actuarial assumption, or consequence of temporarily deviating from substantive plan. Includes, but is not limited to, amount in excess of ten percent of greater of fair value of plan assets or benefit obligation.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Actuarial Net (Gains) Losses (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The net increase or decrease of changes in the value of either the benefit obligation or the plan assets resulting from experience different from that assumed or from a change in an actuarial assumption, or the consequence of a decision to temporarily deviate from the substantive plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Net Prior Service Cost (Credit) (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The amounts in accumulated other comprehensive income related to prior service cost or credit expected to be recognized as components of net periodic benefit cost over the next fiscal year that follows the most recent annual statement of financial position presented.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Discount Rate
concepts.description: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Rate of Compensation Increase
concepts.description: Weighted average rate increase of compensation, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, pay-related defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Discount Rate
concepts.description: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Expected Long-term Rate of Return on Plan Assets
concepts.description: Weighted average rate of return on plan assets, reflecting average rate of earnings expected on existing plan assets and expected contributions, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Rate of Compensation Increase
concepts.description: Weighted average rate of compensation increase used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, pay-related defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The effect of a one-percentage-point decrease in the assumed health care cost trend rates on the accumulated postretirement benefit obligation for health care benefits.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of decrease in accumulated postretirement benefit obligation from one-percentage-point decrease in assumed health care cost trend rate.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Service and Interest Cost Components (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The effect of a one-percentage- point decrease in the assumed health care cost trend rates on the aggregate of the service and interest cost components of net periodic postretirement health care benefit costs.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Service and Interest Cost Components
concepts.description: Amount of decrease in service and interest cost components of net periodic postretirement benefit cost from one-percentage-point decrease in assumed health care cost trend rate.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Increase on Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of increase in accumulated postretirement benefit obligation from one-percentage-point increase in assumed health care cost trend rate.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Increase on Service and Interest Cost Components
concepts.description: Amount of increase in service and interest cost components of net periodic postretirement benefit cost from one-percentage-point increase in assumed health care cost trend rate.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Estimated Future Employer Contributions in Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The employer's best estimate, as soon as it can be reasonably determined, of contributions expected to be paid to the plan during the next fiscal year beginning after the date of the latest statement of financial position. Estimated contributions may be presented in the aggregate combining (1) contributions required by funding regulations or laws, (2) discretionary contributions, and (3) noncash contributions.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year One
concepts.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of asset segregated and restricted to provide benefit under defined benefit plan. Asset includes, but is not limited to, stock, bond, other investment, earning from investment, and contribution by employer and employee.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit)
concepts.description: Amount of net periodic benefit cost (credit) for defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Projected Benefit Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of projected benefit obligation for defined benefit pension plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Benefit Obligation (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of benefit obligation for defined benefit plan with benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Fair Value of Plan Assets (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
concepts.description: Fair value of plan assets for defined benefit plan with benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Special and Contractual Termination Benefits
concepts.description: Amount of increase in benefit obligation for benefits provided to employees payable from defined benefit plan or payable upon retirement.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plans, Estimated Future Employer Contributions in Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of employer's best estimate of contributions expected to be paid to the plan during the next fiscal year beginning after the date of the latest statement of financial position.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Ultimate Health Care Cost Trend Rate (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
concepts.description: The ultimate trend rate for health care costs.

concepts.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Cost
concepts.description: Amount of cost for defined contribution plan.

concepts.label: Deposits Assets, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Carrying value of amounts transferred to third parties for security purposes that are expected to be returned or applied towards payment after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Depreciation
concepts.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

concepts.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
concepts.description: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

concepts.label: Continuing Involvement with Derecognized Transferred Financial Assets, Amount Outstanding
concepts.description: Amount of transferred financial assets in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the assets underlying the transaction that have been derecognized. Continuing involvement includes, but is not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in transferred financial assets.

concepts.label: Derivative Asset Designated as Hedging Instrument, Fair Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
concepts.description: Fair value of a derivative asset (or nonderivative instrument) that is designated and qualifies as a hedging instrument, presented on a gross basis even when the derivative instrument is subject to master netting arrangements and qualifies for net presentation in the statement of financial position.

concepts.label: Derivative Asset, Notional Amount
concepts.description: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on the derivative asset.

concepts.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Amount Not Offset Against Collateral
concepts.description: Fair value, after offset of derivative liability, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, before offset against an obligation to return collateral under a master netting arrangement. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

concepts.label: Derivative Liability Designated as Hedging Instrument, Fair Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
concepts.description: Fair value of a derivative liability (or nonderivative instrument) that is designated and qualifies as a hedging instrument, presented on a gross basis even when the derivative instrument is subject to master netting arrangements and qualifies for net presentation in the statement of financial position.

concepts.label: Derivative, Notional Amount
concepts.description: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payment on derivative.

concepts.label: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise stock options, restrictive stock units (RSUs), convertible preferred stock of an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP), and other dilutive convertible securities.

concepts.label: Direct-to-television Film Costs, Completed and Not Released
concepts.description: The amount of direct negative costs incurred as well as allocations of production overhead and capitalized interest related to the completion of a direct-to-television film not yet released. Examples of direct negative costs include costs of story and scenario; compensation of cast, directors, producers, extras, and miscellaneous staff; costs of set construction and operations, wardrobe, and accessories; costs of sound synchronization; rental facilities on location; and postproduction costs such as music, special effects, and editing.

concepts.label: Direct-to-television Film Costs, Production
concepts.description: The amount of direct negative costs incurred in the production of a direct-to-television film, as well as allocations of production overhead and capitalized interest. Examples of direct negative costs include costs of story and scenario; compensation of cast, directors, producers, extras, and miscellaneous staff; costs of set construction and operations, wardrobe, and accessories; costs of sound synchronization; rental facilities on location; and postproduction costs such as music, special effects, and editing.

concepts.label: Direct-to-television Film Costs, Released
concepts.description: The amount of direct negative costs incurred in the release of a direct-to-television film, as well as allocations of production overhead and capitalized interest. Examples of direct negative costs include costs of story and scenario; compensation of cast, directors, producers, extras, and miscellaneous staff; costs of set construction and operations, wardrobe, and accessories; costs of sound synchronization; rental facilities on location; and postproduction costs such as music, special effects, and editing.

concepts.label: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) from Disposal of Discontinued Operation, before Income Tax
concepts.description: Amount before tax of gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, before Income Tax
concepts.description: Amount before tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

concepts.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, before Income Tax
concepts.description: Amount before tax of income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes gain (loss) on disposal and provision for gain (loss) until its disposal.

concepts.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes gain (loss) on disposal and provision for gain (loss) until disposal.

concepts.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period
concepts.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) on disposal and for provision for gain (loss) until disposal.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
concepts.description: For the disposal group, including a component of the entity (discontinued operation), carrying amount of goodwill (adjusted for any amortization recognized prior to adoption of FAS 142 and impairment charges).

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill
concepts.description: Amount classified as goodwill attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Operating Expense
concepts.description: Amount of operating expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Operating Income (Loss)
concepts.description: Amount of operating income (loss) attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Amount classified as other liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Net (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
concepts.description: For the disposal group, including a component of the entity (discontinued operation), carrying value (net of accumulated depreciation and any write-downs) of tangible assets that are held by an entity for use in the production or supply of goods and services, for rental to others, or for administrative purposes and that are expected to provide economic benefit for more than one year. Examples include land, buildings, machinery and equipment, and other types of furniture and equipment including, but not limited to, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment and software.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Revenue
concepts.description: Amount of revenue attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Dividends
concepts.description: Amount of paid and unpaid cash, stock, and paid-in-kind (PIK) dividends declared, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred stock.

concepts.label: Dividends Payable, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Dividends, Preferred Stock
concepts.description: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

concepts.label: Due to Related Parties, Current
concepts.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of obligations due all related parties. For classified balance sheets, represents the current portion of such liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Due to Related Parties, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Portion of the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of obligations due all related parties that is payable after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
concepts.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
concepts.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

concepts.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Cash Received from Exercise of Stock Options (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
concepts.description: Aggregate proceeds received by the entity during the annual period from exercises of stock or unit options and conversion of similar instruments granted under equity-based payment arrangements.

concepts.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of cost not yet recognized for nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Nonvested Awards, Total Compensation Cost Not yet Recognized, Period for Recognition (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The weighted average period over which unrecognized compensation is expected to be recognized for equity-based compensation plans, using a decimal to express in number of years.

concepts.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense, Tax Benefit
concepts.description: Amount of tax benefit for recognition of expense of award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Tax Benefit Realized from Exercise of Stock Options (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
concepts.description: Disclosure of the aggregate tax benefit realized from the exercise of stock options and the conversion of similar instruments during the annual period.

concepts.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Unrecognized Compensation Costs on Nonvested Awards (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
concepts.description: As of the latest balance sheet date presented, the total compensation cost related to outstanding, nonvested equity-based compensation awards not yet recognized (will be charged against earnings as services are performed or other vesting criteria are met).

concepts.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Unrecognized Compensation Costs on Nonvested Awards, Weighted Average Period of Recognition (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
concepts.description: The weighted average period over which unrecognized equity-based compensation costs are expected to be reported.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution
concepts.description: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return on investment, classified as operating activities. Excludes distribution for return of investment, classified as investing activities.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investment, Net Sales Proceeds (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
concepts.description: This item represents the amount of net sales proceeds received on disposal of an equity method investment.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investment, Other than Temporary Impairment
concepts.description: This item represents an other than temporary decline in value that has been recognized against an investment accounted for under the equity method of accounting. The excess of the carrying amount over the fair value of the investment represents the amount of the write down which is or was reflected in earnings. The written down value is a new cost basis with the adjusted value of the investment becoming its new carrying value subject to the equity accounting method. Evidence of a loss in value might include, but would not necessarily be limited to, absence of an ability to recover the carrying amount of the investment or inability of the investee to sustain an earnings capacity which would justify the carrying amount of the investment.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investment, Quoted Market Value
concepts.description: This item represents the aggregate value of each identified investment accounted for under the equity method of accounting based on the quoted market price for those investments in common stock for which a quoted market price is available.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investment, Amount Sold
concepts.description: Amount of the entity's equity method investment which has been sold.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investments
concepts.description: This item represents the carrying amount on the entity's balance sheet of its investment in common stock of an equity method investee. This is not an indicator of the fair value of the investment, rather it is the initial cost adjusted for the entity's share of earnings and losses of the investee, adjusted for any distributions (dividends) and other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses recognized.

concepts.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Gain (Loss)
concepts.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

concepts.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Gain (Loss)
concepts.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

concepts.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
concepts.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

concepts.label: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation, Financing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow from realized tax benefit related to deductible compensation cost reported on the entity's tax return for equity instruments in excess of the compensation cost for those instruments recognized for financial reporting purposes.

concepts.label: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation, Operating Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow for realized tax benefit related to deductible compensation cost reported on the entity's tax return for equity instruments in excess of the compensation cost for those instruments recognized for financial reporting purposes.

concepts.label: Extinguishment of Debt, Amount
concepts.description: Gross amount of debt extinguished.

concepts.label: Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
concepts.description: Amount of current and deferred federal income tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Film, Capitalized Cost
concepts.description: Amount of capitalized film cost for film predominantly monetized on its own and films predominantly monetized with other films and license agreements as group.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Interest Expense
concepts.description: Amount of interest expense on finance lease liability.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Current
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as current.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payment, Due
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Amortization
concepts.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Accumulated Amortization
concepts.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Amortization
concepts.description: Amount of amortization expense attributable to right-of-use asset from finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, before Accumulated Amortization
concepts.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
concepts.description: Weighted average discount rate for finance lease calculated at point in time.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Accumulated Amortization
concepts.description: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Aggregate amount of intangible asset amortization recognized as expense during the period.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year One
concepts.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Four
concepts.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Three
concepts.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finite Lived Intangible Assets, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
concepts.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Weighted-Average Useful Life (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The calculated weighted-average useful life of all finite-lived intangible assets.

concepts.label: Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
concepts.description: Amount of current and deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Future Amortization Expense, Year Five (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of amortization expense expected to be recognized during year five of the five succeeding fiscal years.

concepts.label: Future Amortization Expense, Year Four (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of amortization expense expected to be recognized during year four of the five succeeding fiscal years.

concepts.label: Future Amortization Expense, Year One (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of amortization expense expected to be recognized during year one of the five succeeding fiscal years.

concepts.label: Future Amortization Expense, Year Three (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of amortization expense expected to be recognized during year three of the five succeeding fiscal years.

concepts.label: Future Amortization Expense, Year Two (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of amortization expense expected to be recognized during year two of the five succeeding fiscal years.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Intangible Assets
concepts.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of intangible assets.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Equity Investments
concepts.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of equity securities, not separately or otherwise categorized as trading or available-for-sale. This element includes investments in which the entity holds a small ownership stake (generally, less than 20% of the shares outstanding) and cannot exert significant influence.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Assets and Asset Impairment Charges
concepts.description: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the sale price or salvage price and the book value of an asset that was sold or retired, and gain (loss) from the write down of assets from their carrying value to fair value.

concepts.label: Goodwill
concepts.description: Amount after accumulated impairment loss of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Acquired During Period
concepts.description: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

concepts.label: Goodwill and Intangible Asset Impairment
concepts.description: Total loss recognized during the period from the impairment of goodwill plus the loss recognized in the period resulting from the impairment of the carrying amount of intangible assets, other than goodwill.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
concepts.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) an asset representing future economic benefits from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
concepts.description: Amount of loss from the write-down of an asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Other Changes (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of other (increase) decrease of an asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Other Increase (Decrease)
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease), classified as other, of an asset representing the future economic benefits from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Transfers
concepts.description: Amount of transfers into (out of) an asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Translation Adjustments (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
