concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from foreign currency translation adjustments of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Written off Related to Sale of Business Unit
concepts.description: Amount of divestiture of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Guarantor Obligations, Current Carrying Value
concepts.description: The current carrying amount of the liability for the freestanding or embedded guarantor's obligations under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees.

concepts.label: Guarantor Obligations, Maximum Exposure, Undiscounted
concepts.description: Maximum potential amount of future payments (undiscounted) the guarantor could be required to make under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees before reduction for potential recoveries under recourse or collateralization provisions.

concepts.label: Impairment of Intangible Assets, Indefinite-lived (Excluding Goodwill)
concepts.description: Amount of impairment loss resulting from write-down of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit to fair value.

concepts.label: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets Held-for-use
concepts.description: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long lived assets held for use (including those held for disposal by means other than sale).

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
concepts.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the parent.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
concepts.description: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Foreign
concepts.description: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Equity Method Investments, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of income (loss) from equity method investments.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic Share
concepts.description: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Diluted Share
concepts.description: The amount of net income (loss) derived from continuing operations during the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share
concepts.description: Per basic share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
concepts.description: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments
concepts.description: Amount of income (loss) for proportionate share of equity method investee's income (loss).

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments, Net of Dividends or Distributions
concepts.description: This element represents the undistributed income (or loss) of equity method investments, net of dividends or other distributions received from unconsolidated subsidiaries, certain corporate joint ventures, and certain noncontrolled corporations; such investments are accounted for under the equity method of accounting. This element excludes distributions that constitute a return of investment, which are classified as investing activities.

concepts.label: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Cumulative Effect of Change in Accounting Principle
concepts.description: Amount of cumulative tax effect on beginning retained earnings from change in accounting principle.

concepts.label: Income Tax Examination, Liability (Refund) Adjustment from Settlement with Taxing Authority
concepts.description: The amount of the additional liability or refund received or expected based on a final settlement with a taxing authority.

concepts.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The sum of the current income tax expense or benefit and the deferred income tax expense or benefit pertaining to pretax Income or Loss from continuing operations; income tax expense or benefit may include interest and penalties on tax uncertainties based on the entity's accounting policy.

concepts.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net
concepts.description: The amount of cash paid during the current period to foreign, federal, state, and local authorities as taxes on income, net of any cash received during the current period as refunds for the overpayment of taxes.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to increase (decrease) in the income tax rates.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Other, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other deductions.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Asset, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to disposition of asset. Includes, but is not limited to, intra-entity transfer of asset other than inventory.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Business, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the disposition of a business not qualifying as a discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax expense (benefit).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
concepts.description: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Noncontrolling Interest Income (Loss), Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to noncontrolling interest income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Impairment Losses, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible impairment loss.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Reconciling Items, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax exempt income, equity in earnings (loss) of an unconsolidated subsidiary, minority noncontrolling interest income (loss), tax holiday, disposition of a business, disposition of an asset, repatriation of foreign earnings, repatriation of foreign earnings jobs creation act of 2004, increase (decrease) in enacted tax rate, prior year income taxes, increase (decrease) in deferred tax asset valuation allowance, and other adjustments.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Repatriation of Foreign Earnings, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to repatriation of foreign earnings.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax expense (benefit).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Foreign, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign tax credit.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax settlements. Including, but not limited to, domestic tax settlement, foreign tax settlement, state and local tax settlement, and other tax settlements.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Domestic, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to domestic income tax settlement.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to vendors for goods and services received and the amount of obligations and expenses incurred but not paid.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Liabilities
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities that result from activities that generate operating income.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in other obligations or expenses incurred but not yet paid.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, Net
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets after deduction of operating liabilities classified as other.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due within one year (or one operating cycle) from all parties, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

concepts.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Call Options and Warrants
concepts.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of call options and warrants using the treasury stock method.

concepts.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Share-based Payment Arrangements
concepts.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of share based payment arrangements using the treasury stock method.

concepts.label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill)
concepts.description: Amount of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit.

concepts.label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Impairment Losses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Impairment recognized during the period and allocated to the reportable segment that results from the write-down of indefinite-lived intangible assets after comparing the implied fair value of reporting unit indefinite-lived intangible assets with the carrying amount of that indefinite-lived intangible assets, which are assessed at least annually for impairment.

concepts.label: Indefinite-Lived License Agreements
concepts.description: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the capitalized costs to acquire rights under a license arrangement (for example, to sell specified products in a specified territory) having an indefinite period of benefit.

concepts.label: Interest Costs Capitalized
concepts.description: Amount of interest capitalized during the period.

concepts.label: Interest Costs Capitalized Adjustment
concepts.description: Amount of interest costs capitalized disclosed as an adjusting item to interest costs incurred.

concepts.label: Interest Costs Incurred
concepts.description: Total interest costs incurred during the period and either capitalized or charged against earnings.

concepts.label: Interest Expense
concepts.description: Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense.

concepts.label: Interest Paid, Including Capitalized Interest, Operating and Investing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, including, but not limited to, capitalized interest and payment to settle zero-coupon bond attributable to accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount; classified as operating and investing activities.

concepts.label: Interest Paid, Capitalized, Investing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash paid for interest capitalized, classified as investing activity.

concepts.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

concepts.label: Interest Payable, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of [accrued] interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred and is unpaid. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) to be Reclassified During Next 12 Months, Net
concepts.description: The estimated net amount of unrealized gains or losses on interest rate cash flow hedges as of the balance sheet date expected to be reclassified to earnings within the next twelve months.

concepts.label: Inventory, Net
concepts.description: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Rent Expense
concepts.description: Amount of rent expense incurred for leased assets, including but not limited to, furniture and equipment, that is not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease due after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease having initial or remaining lease term in excess of one year to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

concepts.label: Liabilities
concepts.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities that are recognized. Liabilities are probable future sacrifices of economic benefits arising from present obligations of an entity to transfer assets or provide services to other entities in the future.

concepts.label: Liabilities and Equity
concepts.description: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

concepts.label: Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Liabilities, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount of obligation due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities
concepts.description: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Borrowing Capacity
concepts.description: Maximum borrowing capacity under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt
concepts.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation, Current
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation, Including Current Maturities
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, including portion classified as current.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt, Current Maturities
concepts.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt, classified as current. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, after Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year One
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Four
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Three
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
concepts.description: Amount after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs of long-term debt classified as noncurrent and excluding amounts to be repaid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate, over Time
concepts.description: Weighted average interest rate of long-term debt outstanding calculated over time.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate, at Point in Time
concepts.description: Weighted average interest rate of long-term debt outstanding calculated at point in time.

concepts.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Provision
concepts.description: Amount charged against operating income increasing loss contingency liability, after adjustments to reduce previously estimated charges.

concepts.label: Losses (Gains) on Sales of Assets and Asset Impairment Charges (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The aggregate impact on earnings in the period of (a) the loss (gain) from the difference between the sale price or salvage price and the book value of an asset that was sold or retired during the reporting period, and (b) the charge against earnings resulting from the aggregate write down of all assets from their carrying value to their fair value.

concepts.label: Loss from Components Excluded from Assessment of Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness
concepts.description: The loss relating to components of the gain (loss) on the cash flow hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

concepts.label: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Total of all stockholders' equity (deficit) items, net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity which is directly or indirectly attributable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (that is, noncontrolling interest, previously referred to as minority interest).

concepts.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Distributions to Noncontrolling Interest Holders
concepts.description: Decrease in noncontrolling interest balance from payment of dividends or other distributions by the non-wholly owned subsidiary or partially owned entity, included in the consolidation of the parent entity, to the noncontrolling interest holders.

concepts.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activities, including discontinued operations. Financing activity cash flows include obtaining resources from owners and providing them with a return on, and a return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amounts borrowed, or settling the obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resources obtained from creditors on long-term credit.

concepts.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities, Continuing Operations
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of financing activities, excluding discontinued operations. Financing activity cash flows include obtaining resources from owners and providing them with a return on, and a return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amounts borrowed, or settling the obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resources obtained from creditors on long-term credit.

concepts.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activities, including discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.

concepts.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities, Continuing Operations
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of investing activities, excluding discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.

concepts.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

concepts.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities, Continuing Operations
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, excluding discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
concepts.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
concepts.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted
concepts.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

concepts.label: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Cumulative Effect of Change on Equity or Net Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of cumulative effect of the change in accounting principle or new accounting pronouncement on retained earnings or other components of equity or net assets in the statement of financial position as of the beginning of the earliest period presented.

concepts.label: Nonoperating Income (Expense)
concepts.description: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

concepts.label: Notes Payable, Fair Value Disclosure
concepts.description: Fair value portion of notes payable.

concepts.label: Number of Reportable Segments
concepts.description: Number of segments reported by the entity. A reportable segment is a component of an entity for which there is an accounting requirement to report separate financial information on that component in the entity's financial statements.

concepts.label: Number of States in which Entity Operates
concepts.description: The number of states the entity operates in as of the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: OCI, before Reclassifications, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
concepts.description: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments, of other comprehensive income (loss), attributable to parent.

concepts.label: Operating Expenses
concepts.description: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

concepts.label: Operating Income (Loss)
concepts.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Cost
concepts.description: Amount of single lease cost, calculated by allocation of remaining cost of lease over remaining lease term. Includes, but is not limited to, single lease cost, after impairment of right-of-use asset, calculated by amortization of remaining right-of-use asset and accretion of lease liability.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Payments
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease, excluding payments to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due, Next Twelve Months
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Five Years
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Four Years
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Three Years
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Two Years
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due Thereafter
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
concepts.description: Weighted average discount rate for operating lease calculated at point in time.

concepts.label: Other Accrued Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Current
concepts.description: Amount of current assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Pension Cost, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The adjustment out of other comprehensive income for prior service costs recognized as a component of net period benefit cost during the period, after tax.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Pension Cost, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Tax effect of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment for prior service costs recognized as a component of net period benefit cost.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax, of cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax, of gain (loss) for (increase) decrease in value of benefit obligation for change in actuarial assumptions and increase (decrease) in value of plan assets from experience different from that assumed of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, Tax
concepts.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for (increase) decrease in value of benefit obligation for change in actuarial assumptions and increase (decrease) in value of plan assets from experience different from that assumed of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Adjustment that results from the process of translating subsidiary financial statements and foreign equity investments into the reporting currency of the reporting entity, net of tax.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to noncontrolling interests.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
concepts.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to parent entity.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss), before Reclassification and Tax
concepts.description: Amount before tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Tax effect of the adjustment that results from the process of translating subsidiary financial statements and foreign equity investments into functional currency of the reporting entity. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a credit balance consistent with its label.

concepts.label: OCI, Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss), Arising During Period, Tax
concepts.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), before reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax
concepts.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
concepts.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Pension Cost, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Net of tax amount of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment for prior service costs recognized as a component of net period benefit cost.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Pension Cost, Tax Effect (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Tax effect on adjustment out of other comprehensive income for prior service costs recognized as a component of net period benefit cost during the period.

concepts.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

concepts.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment and Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax and adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Reclassifications, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax and before reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification, Tax
concepts.description: Amount, before reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, Tax
concepts.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for translation gain (loss) realized upon the sale or liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity and foreign currency hedges that are designated and qualified as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Tax
concepts.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for translation gain (loss) realized upon the sale or liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity and foreign currency hedges that are designated and qualified as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Net of tax amount of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment for translation gain (loss) realized upon the sale or complete or substantially complete liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity. Also includes reclassification adjustments on foreign currency hedges that are designated and qualified as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Tax effect of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment for translation gain (loss) realized upon the sale or complete or substantially complete liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity. Also includes reclassification adjustments on foreign currency hedges that are designated and qualified as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: This element represents Other Comprehensive Income or Loss, Net of Tax, for the period. Includes deferred gains or losses on qualifying hedges, unrealized holding gains or losses on available-for-sale securities, minimum pension liability, and cumulative translation adjustment. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a credit balance consistent with its label.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interests.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
concepts.description: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, before Reclassification Adjustment, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax, before reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Tax
concepts.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Before tax amount of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Net of tax amount of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Tax effect of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Sale of Securities, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Sale of Securities, Tax
concepts.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI on Derivatives, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income of accumulated gain (loss) realized from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI on Derivatives, Tax
concepts.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income of accumulated gain (loss) realized from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Net of tax amount of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment of accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges realized in net income. Also includes reclassification adjustments of an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss) realized in net income.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Tax effect of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment of accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges realized in net income. Also includes reclassification adjustments of an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss) realized in net income.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Reclassification adjustment for unrealized gains or losses realized upon the sale of securities, after tax.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Tax effect on the reclassification adjustment for gains or losses realized upon the sale of securities during the period.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Net of tax effect of the reclassification adjustment for accumulated gains and losses from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges included in accumulated comprehensive income that was realized in net income during the period.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Tax effect on reclassification adjustment for accumulated gains and losses from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges included in accumulated comprehensive income that was realized in net income during the period.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, Tax
concepts.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), before reclassification adjustments, related to increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

concepts.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

concepts.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax
concepts.description: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

concepts.label: Other Cost of Operating Revenue
concepts.description: Other costs incurred during the reporting period related to other revenue generating activities.

concepts.label: Other Cost of Services (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
concepts.description: Other costs incurred and are directly related to services rendered by an entity during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Other Intangible Assets, Net
concepts.description: Amount after accumulated amortization of finite-lived and indefinite-lived intangible assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Long-term Debt
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Long-term Debt, Current
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt classified as other, payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Noncurrent Liabilities (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
concepts.description: Obligations not otherwise itemized or previously categorized that are due beyond one year (or operating cycle, if longer) from the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense)
concepts.description: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

concepts.label: Payment for Other Postretirement Benefits
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow for other postretirement benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes pension benefit.

concepts.label: Other Revenue, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount, after sales adjustments, returns, allowances, and discounts, of revenue classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Selling, General and Administrative Expense
concepts.description: Amount of selling, general and administrative expense classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of other income tax expense (benefit).

concepts.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Investments
concepts.description: The net cash paid (received) associated with the acquisition or disposal of all investments, including securities and other assets.

concepts.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activities classified as other.

concepts.label: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock
concepts.description: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

concepts.label: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: The cash outflow during the period for redemption of redeemable noncontrolling interests.

concepts.label: Payments of Dividends
concepts.description: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

concepts.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Additional Interest in Subsidiaries
concepts.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of noncontrolling interest during the period.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired
concepts.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Equity Method Investments
concepts.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of or advances to an equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets
concepts.description: The cash outflow for purchases of and capital improvements on property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
concepts.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

concepts.label: Payment for Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree.

concepts.label: Payment for Pension Benefits
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow for pension benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes other postretirement benefit.

concepts.label: Postemployment Benefits Liability, Current
concepts.description: For a classified balance sheet, the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the portion of the obligations recognized for the various benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement that is payable within one year of the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Postemployment Benefits Liability
concepts.description: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the obligations recognized for the various benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement.

concepts.label: Postemployment Benefits Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.description: For a classified balance sheet, the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the portion of the obligations recognized for the various benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement that is payable after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Dividend Rate, Percentage
concepts.description: The percentage rate used to calculate dividend payments on preferred stock.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock Dividends, Income Statement Impact
concepts.description: The amount of preferred stock dividends that is an adjustment to net income apportioned to common stockholders.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
concepts.description: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized
concepts.description: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Issued
concepts.description: Total number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) issued to shareholders (includes related preferred shares that were issued, repurchased, and remain in the treasury). May be all or portion of the number of preferred shares authorized. Excludes preferred shares that are classified as debt.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Outstanding
concepts.description: Aggregate share number for all nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by stockholders. Does not include preferred shares that have been repurchased.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Issued
concepts.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

concepts.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current
concepts.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Prepaid Expense, Current
concepts.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, after Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Five Fiscal Years Thereafter (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Aggregate amount for the next five fiscal years following the first five fiscal years (that is the aggregate of fiscal years six through ten) following the balance sheet date of the prescription drug subsidy receipts expected to be received.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year One
concepts.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Year Five (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of the prescription drug subsidy receipts expected to be received in Year 5 after the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Year Four (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of the prescription drug subsidy receipts expected to be received in Year 4 after the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year Four
concepts.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Year One (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of the prescription drug subsidy receipts expected to be received in Year 1 after the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Year Three (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of the prescription drug subsidy receipts expected to be received in Year 3 after the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year Three
concepts.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in third fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Year Two (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of the prescription drug subsidy receipts expected to be received in Year 2 after the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in second fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Collection of Finance Receivables
concepts.description: The cash inflow associated with the collection of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Collection of Long-term Loans to Related Parties
concepts.description: The cash inflow associated with collection, whether partial or full, of long-term loans to a related party. Alternate caption: Proceeds from Advances to Affiliates.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses and Interests in Affiliates
concepts.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a business segment or subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled during the period (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, joint venture or equity method investment).

concepts.label: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution, Return of Capital
concepts.description: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return of investment, classified as investing activities. Excludes distribution for return on investment, classified as operating activities.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Commercial Paper
concepts.description: The cash inflow from borrowing by issuing commercial paper.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Debt
concepts.description: The cash inflow during the period from additional borrowings in aggregate debt. Includes proceeds from short-term and long-term debt.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-term Debt
concepts.description: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Other Long-term Debt
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of long-term debt classified as other.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
concepts.description: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholders and which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Senior Long-term Debt
concepts.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer).

concepts.label: Proceeds from Noncontrolling Interests
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow from a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, purchase of additional shares or other increase in noncontrolling interest ownership.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Other Debt
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow from debt classified as other.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Other Short-term Debt
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow from short-term debt classified as other.

concepts.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Other Financing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activities classified as other.

concepts.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Commercial Paper
concepts.description: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from issuing (borrowing) and repaying commercial paper.

concepts.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Related Party Debt
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt by a related party. Related parties, include, but are not limited to, affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, and pension trusts.

concepts.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
concepts.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Finance Receivables
concepts.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale or collection of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Finance Receivables
concepts.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Receivable
concepts.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Productive Assets
concepts.description: The cash inflow from the sale of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Treasury Stock
concepts.description: The cash inflow from the issuance of an equity stock that has been previously reacquired by the entity.
